entities.name: Ghan
entities.description: A Drix wefthunter who hunts Eldrazi-corrupted people with a seam-ripper, grieving his partner Sorothir, and tracks Kesori Umberlin's stolen artifact.

entities.name: Sorothir
entities.description: Ghan's late partner in hunting and in love, who died in the line of duty.

entities.name: Jadnis
entities.description: A Drix consultant and Pinnacle archivist on Pellerife, friend of Ghan and Sorothir, who supplies research and calls out Ghan's recklessness.

entities.name: Kesori Umberlin
entities.description: A human third-degree elevator-loading technician on Andenstalay who obtains an Eldrazi-tainted artifact to try to bring back her sister Errit and is drained by it.

entities.name: Errit
entities.description: Kesori's sister, who died in the botched evacuation of Cail Station.

entities.name: Oscillus Cail
entities.description: A figure tied to the botched Cail Station evacuation whom Ghan vows to hunt.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A Kav identified as an emerging protobeing, Ghan's next target.

entities.name: Seam-ripper
entities.description: Ghan's blade that parts the Weft to open passages between lamellae.

entities.name: The Cail artifact
entities.description: A blood-brown gnarled Eldrazi-tainted device that corrupts Drix weftwalking secrets, lets a human tear through space and time, and drains its user.

entities.name: Cail Station
entities.description: An abandoned station evacuated twenty years earlier, where a corruption wound in the Weft is found.

entities.name: Andenstalay
entities.description: A smoggy city of tram tracks and monorails with a space elevator, where Kesori works and where artifact damage kills two.

entities.name: Pellerife
entities.description: The world of the Pinnacle archives where Jadnis works.

entities.name: Ssata
entities.description: The world where Kesori and Errit once lived in a one-room apartment.

entities.name: The Weft
entities.description: The layered fabric of reality that Drix can walk without an eternity drive.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings beyond the Chaos Wall whose corruption taints people and artifacts, which the Drix remember and fight.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: The people who can walk the Weft unaided and remember the Eldrazi war.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The administrators of Pinnacle space whose archives and enforcement agents operate in the lamellae.

events.summary: Ghan weftwalks into the abandoned Cail Station and feels the wrongness within.
events.quote: The moment Ghan's seam-ripper parted space, cutting a radiant blue line from the void into the station's dark, debris-strewn arcade, he felt the change.

events.summary: Ghan finds a scabbed wound in the Weft itself that no seam-ripper could make.
events.quote: Ghan also made out a second wound overlaid on the first: not in the infrastructure of the station, but in the Weft itself.

events.summary: Ghan contacts Jadnis for help searching the station's records.
events.quote: Jadnis. It's me.

events.summary: Jadnis tells Ghan of similar damage on Andenstalay that killed two.
events.quote: Two people died; no local leads on the causative agent.

events.summary: Ghan weftwalks to Andenstalay.
events.quote: At a touch, the Weft parted to let him step through into a higher lamella, out across the superstructure of reality.

events.summary: Ghan senses that elevator technician Kesori Umberlin is the source of the contamination.
events.quote: And the surge of nausea that struck Ghan meant she was the source of the contamination.

events.summary: Kesori refuses to talk and flees from Ghan.
events.quote: "No," she said, and bolted.

events.summary: Ghan chases Kesori through the city by microstepping through the Weft.
events.quote: A split second later, he dropped out of a shining slit in the air, a scant few meters in front of Kesori.

events.summary: Ghan mistimes a cut and falls from a monorail platform, but Kesori catches him.
events.quote: And then he was swinging, not falling.

events.summary: Kesori activates the artifact and uses it to tear a passage out of Andenstalay, wounding the Weft and wrecking the monorail.
events.quote: A strange singularity churned out of artifact and wrapped itself around her.

events.summary: The rebound snaps the monorail sideways and passengers are hurt.
events.quote: The rebound snapped the monorail sideways.

events.summary: Ghan realizes Kesori now holds a stolen Drix means of piercing space and time.
events.quote: And now Kesori Umberlin was the one being in the universe who held a way to pierce through space and time.

events.summary: Ghan lands in Jadnis's office on Pellerife to research the name Errit.
events.quote: When Ghan tumbled out into Jadnis's office on Pellerife, he landed so hard

events.summary: The archives reveal the botched Cail Station evacuation that left Errit dead.
events.quote: the botched evacuation of Cail Station that had prioritized the retrieval of expensive, specialized mining equipment over the lives of its residents.

events.summary: Ghan vows to hunt Oscillus Cail after destroying the artifact.
events.quote: I'm going to track down Oscillus Cail and the rest, and I'm going to …

events.summary: Jadnis tells Ghan his job is Eldrazi and not everybody else.
events.quote: Your job is dealing with Eldrazi. And mine is dealing with everybody else.

events.summary: Ghan's hunt-ache and Kesori's files point him toward the world Ssata.
events.quote: pointed him toward the world called Ssata.

events.summary: Ghan cuts into Kesori's bare apartment on Ssata and finds her diminished.
events.quote: With his best judgment, he angled his seam-ripper and sliced through into an ugly, unfurnished one-room apartment.

events.summary: Kesori reveals she can jump only a few weeks in time with the artifact.
events.quote: I've only ever managed to jump a few weeks.

events.summary: Kesori says the artifact called to her as if it knew she needed it.
events.quote: It … called me. As if it knew I needed it.

events.summary: Kesori says she will bring Errit back to the apartment.
events.quote: I took her away—but I can bring her back here.

events.summary: Kesori uses the artifact and blows a hole in the wall and tears the Weft.
events.quote: Kesori had blown a hole through the external wall, and a wavering tear in the Weft shimmered through the morning-hazy air of the city.

events.summary: Ghan kicks the artifact from Kesori, who is left limp as a broken toy, dead after the artifact finishes its work.
events.quote: Whatever it had already taken from her, it had finished its work: she lay like a child's broken toy.

events.summary: The ceiling collapses and pins Ghan beneath rubble.
events.quote: He looked up in time to see the ceiling above him shear in half.

events.summary: Pinned, Ghan finds the artifact and resolves to use it.
events.quote: Instead of purchase, his fingers found the artifact.

events.summary: Ghan tears the Weft-wound open and forces himself through it.
events.quote: He ripped the Weft-wound wide open and forced himself through.

events.summary: Ghan, in the Weft, resists the artifact's attempt to open a window to a best-forgotten past.
events.quote: Not much control. But enough to force closed that sickening window to a best-forgotten past.

events.summary: Ghan glimpses a young Kesori and Errit in the past.
events.quote: Kesori and Errit. Young and hungry and happy.

events.summary: Ghan is tempted to reach back to the day Sorothir died but chooses not to.
events.quote: But he didn't break, even though everything in him longed to.

events.summary: Ghan travels back to Andenstalay weeks earlier and warns Kesori not to go through with her plan.
events.quote: You don't have to go it alone. But Errit wouldn't want you to do this.

events.summary: Once Kesori lets go of the artifact, Ghan flees back through the rites.
events.quote: The moment she let go of the artifact, Ghan bawled out the rites.

events.summary: Ghan returns to his own present and finds the apartment's destruction overlaid on an intact original.
events.quote: He lost track of how long it took to claw his way back to his own present, where he pawed at the weft-wound until he fell through.

events.summary: Ghan cuts the artifact in half with his seam-ripper, destroying it.
events.quote: Half of the artifact dropped to the floor with a clatter of finality.

events.summary: Jadnis reveals that Kesori is alive and her assistant, and gives Ghan a new target, the Kav Tannuk.
events.quote: There's a protobeing emerging, a Kav called Tannuk.

events.summary: Ghan accepts the new hunt, resolved that dealing with the Eldrazi is his job.
events.quote: I've been told by a reputable source that dealing with the Eldrazi is my job. So, yes. I'm on it.

relations.note: Old friends; Jadnis patched up Ghan and Sorothir for years.
relations.quote: Every time I planned a lunch date, you and Sorothir would drop in on me demanding to be patched up.

relations.note: Ghan feels Sorothir's love lingering in the Weft.
relations.quote: he felt—or pretended?—that Sorothir's love lingered

relations.note: Jadnis is on assignment to the Pinnacle archives.
relations.quote: Jadnis was a consultant, on assignment to the Pinnacle archives on Pellerife
walking the Weft was a Drix's birthright.

relations.note: Ghan has particular reason to loathe the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: And Ghan had more reason than most Drix to loathe the Eldrazi.

relations.note: Kesori ends up as Jadnis's assistant.
relations.quote: My assistant? The one who brought me the Cail lead in the first place?
